tools.name: run
tools.description: Structured data validator in one call: extracts JSON-LD, microdata and RDFa from a URL or raw HTML, then reports the required and recommended Google Rich Results fields missing per @type. Covers the three syntaxes programmatically, where the reference validators are manual web tools with no public A

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "run" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
